properties.name: Ixchel
properties.description: Maya goddess of the moon, medicine, and weaving. Depicted as an old woman with a serpent on her head, pouring water. Patron of midwives.

properties.name: Kukulkan
properties.description: Maya Feathered Serpent deity, counterpart of Aztec Quetzalcoatl. During equinoxes, his shadow serpent descends El Castillo pyramid at Chichén Itzá.

properties.name: Chaac
properties.description: Maya rain god with a lightning axe. Four Chaacs govern the four directions. His long nose represents rain clouds. Essential for maize agriculture.

properties.name: Ah Puch
properties.description: Skeletal Maya death god who ruled Mitnal (ninth level of Xibalba). Wore bells, owl feathers, and rotting flesh. Associated with war and sacrifice.
